fresh.newer_info: ccfddl has new information for the {year} edition: {what}
fresh.link_changed: ccfddl's link for the {year} edition changed: {link}
fresh.dates_changed: ccfddl's deadlines for the {year} edition changed: {dates}
fresh.link_unknown: ccfddl's link for the {year} edition ({link}) is not among the website, CFP or sources in the details
fresh.dates_new: ccfddl lists deadlines for the {year} edition that the details don't have: {dates}
fresh.no_edition: The details don't say which edition they describe
fresh.older_edition: The details are for the {year} edition; ccfddl already has the {upcoming} edition
fresh.no_verified: No date of the last check is recorded

fresh.age.one: Last checked on {date}, {n} month ago (limit: {limit} months)
fresh.age.other: Last checked on {date}, {n} months ago (limit: {limit} months)

check.no_details: {acronym} has no details yet, so there is nothing to check
check.gone: This check result was already handled or no longer exists
check.conflict: The venue details changed after the assistant's check (for example, another Mac updated them). Check again.
